As of 23 March, 2023, Calvin greets Dave, expressing pleasure in meeting him and inquiring about how things have been since their last conversation. Dave responds enthusiastically, sharing that he attended an incredible event recently that he describes as a car lover's paradise, featuring many classic cars on display. He expresses awe at the event and mentions having the opportunity to speak with car owners, hearing their fascinating stories, which he found super inspiring. Calvin responds positively to Dave's event, sharing that he has experienced a big life change and shows Dave a photo of his new mansion, which he describes as cool. Dave congratulates Calvin on this significant change and asks what inspired him to start this journey. Calvin expresses excitement about learning Japanese culture and the chance to expand his horizons. Dave, impressed, asks if Calvin has ever been to Japan, to which Calvin replies that he has never been but is fascinated by the traditions and cannot wait to experience the culture. Dave expresses his anticipation for Calvin's trip and inquires about when he is leaving. Calvin shares that he is heading to Japan next month and will be staying in a nice place, showing Dave a photo of a cozy living room with a couch, table, and television. Dave comments on the coziness of the place and asks where Calvin found it. Calvin credits his agent for finding the awesome place and expresses gratitude. Dave emphasizes the importance of having a good place to stay and asks about Calvin's plans for the trip. Calvin shares that he plans to explore the city, try different local cuisines, and possibly collaborate with musicians in the area. Dave expresses excitement about the collaboration and asks how long Calvin plans to stay in Japan. Calvin mentions he will be in Japan for a few months before heading to Boston, expressing eagerness for the trip. Dave shares that he has been spending a lot of time at a beautiful park lately, which he finds calming, and asks if Calvin has been there before, showing a photo of a park with a lake and a few boats. Calvin admits he has never been to the park but finds it looks like a chill spot and appreciates the tip. Dave wishes Calvin an enjoyable trip and offers to help with recommendations if needed. Calvin thanks Dave and assures him he will reach out if he needs help, wishing him to stay safe.
As of 19 October, 2023, Calvin greets Dave and mentions that it has been a few days since they last talked, sharing that he has started touring with Frank Ocean. He describes the experience as amazing, highlighting the energy from the crowd and the connection he feels when performing on stage. Calvin shows a photo of a band performing on stage with bright lights, expressing how unreal the experience has been. Dave congratulates Calvin, stating that performing for a crowd must feel incredible. He inquires about how the tour is going, and Calvin responds that the tour is great, with awesome energy from the crowd and jamming with Frank Ocean being a dream come true. Dave expresses excitement, noting that performing with Frank Ocean must be like a dream come true. Calvin shares that they met at a festival in August of the previous year, where Frank expressed interest in collaborating, and they clicked right away with incredible chemistry on stage. Calvin shows a photo of him and Frank performing together on stage, emphasizing how well they look together. Dave praises their synergy and expresses eagerness to catch one of their shows. Calvin shares a photo of a large crowd of people in a large auditorium, describing the crowd's energy as insane. Dave expresses excitement about experiencing the show, confident that the crowd will be pumped up. Calvin shares a photo of a crowd of people at a concert with their hands in the air, emphasizing the amazing energy. Dave admires the photo and asks where it was taken, to which Calvin reveals it was taken in Tokyo during a concert, describing the energy as nuts. Dave expresses his desire to visit Tokyo, sharing a photo of a busy street with people walking and shopping, and mentions that the energy there seems unbeatable. Calvin confirms that visiting similar streets in Tokyo was an incredible experience and asks Dave if there is anything else he is interested in regarding Tokyo. Dave expresses his eagerness to learn about the people, culture, food, and vibrant city life. He shares a photo of a crowded street at night, describing it as alive and colorful. Calvin shows a photo of a city at night with a tall building in the background, expressing a desire to return to such places. Dave asks Calvin about specific spots he is excited to check out in Tokyo, and Calvin mentions Shibuya Crossing and Shinjuku, expressing excitement about the amazing food there. Dave encourages Calvin to try ramen in Tokyo, sharing a photo of a ramen bowl he tried in Boston and expressing that it was delicious but believes it will be even better in Tokyo. Calvin expresses his intention to try ramen in Tokyo and appreciates Dave's encouragement.
As of 16 May, 2023, Calvin reaches out to Dave, noting that it has been a long time since they last chatted and sharing that a lot has happened since their last conversation. Dave greets Calvin and reciprocates, asking how everything has been since they last caught up. Calvin shares that not everything has been going smoothly, revealing that he had an incident last week where his place got flooded. He expresses gratitude for managing to save his music gear, particularly his favorite microphone, despite the tough situation. Dave expresses sympathy for Calvin's situation, stating that he is sorry to hear about the flooding but is glad Calvin saved his important music gear. He encourages Calvin to stay positive and asks if there is anything he can do to help. Calvin appreciates Dave's support and shares that he is waiting on insurance to kick in to start repairs, hoping it won't take too long. He shows Dave a photo of his creative haven, a music studio filled with a keyboard, synthesizer, and other musical equipment. Dave admires the studio and expresses hope that Calvin can get it fixed soon so he can continue creating music. Calvin expresses eagerness to get back to making music. Dave shares that he opened his car shop last week and invited friends to celebrate, describing the experience as amazing and expressing excitement about sharing his passion and helping with people's rides. Calvin congratulates Dave on opening his car shop, expressing that his excitement is contagious. Dave thanks Calvin for the support, sharing that it has been quite a journey so far and he is excited to see what the future holds. Calvin shares that he is super excited for his upcoming performance in Tokyo this month, expressing hope that he can show his music to a new crowd and expand his following. Dave expresses enthusiasm for Calvin's performance in Tokyo, stating that he is sure the audience will love it and wishing him luck. Calvin promises to keep Dave posted on how it goes and thanks him for the good luck wishes. He shares a photo of a city at night with a lot of lights, explaining that he took the picture in Tokyo the previous night and found the skyline stunning. Dave admires the photo, commenting on how the night skyline pops with city lights and expresses a desire to take a trip to Tokyo soon. Calvin encourages Dave to visit, stating that the city is awesome and the lights are amazing.
As of 20 April, 2023, Calvin greets Dave, expressing that it has been a long time since they last spoke. Calvin shares that he attended an awesome music festival in Tokyo, describing it as cool. Dave responds enthusiastically, asking how the music was in Tokyo and if there were any cool bands. Calvin explains that the festival was awesome, but he did not see any bands; instead, he met many talented artists and industry people, which he found enriching. Dave expresses excitement and asks what Calvin learned from the experience. Calvin shares that he learned a lot and received great advice from professionals in the music industry, which he found inspiring. Dave acknowledges the motivation of being surrounded by professionals and asks if Calvin received any specific advice. Calvin shares that a producer advised him to stay true to himself and to have a unique sound, which got him thinking about the direction he wants his music to take. Dave expresses admiration for Calvin's motivation to stay true to himself and asks where Calvin sees his music taking him. Calvin shares that he dreams of touring the world, performing for different people, and connecting with them, hoping his music can reach a global audience and make an impact. He mentions looking forward to his upcoming trip to Boston after finishing the Frank Ocean tour, expressing excitement about the music scene there. Dave expresses eagerness to show Calvin around Boston, mentioning cool spots like Paradise Rock, House of Blues, and Fenway Park, assuring Calvin he will have great performances there. Dave shares a photo of a city skyline with a boat in the water. Calvin admires the photo and thanks Dave for the tips. Dave shares that he attended a car show last weekend, describing classic cars as charming and expressing his dedication to restoring them, which is why he is into auto engineering. He promises to show Calvin some cars when he visits Boston and shares a photo of a green Mustang parked in a field of grass. Calvin admires the car and mentions his own car, sharing a photo of his red sports car on display at a show. Dave acknowledges the effort that goes into restoring cars and asks if Calvin has had a chance to check out Boston apart from gigs. Calvin admits he has not yet explored the city due to being busy with rehearsals and traveling but expresses eagerness to try delicious food and visit popular attractions. He suggests they grab a bite together when he is in Boston. Dave enthusiastically agrees to show Calvin his favorite spots in the city, expressing excitement about their upcoming time together.
As of 7 July, 2023, Dave checks in with Calvin, asking how his car is doing after the crash and expressing excitement about Calvin getting back on the road. Calvin responds that his car is good now, as it has been fixed and is going strong, stating that there is nothing better than cruising around. He shares a photo of his red sports car parked on the side of the road. Dave expresses gladness that Calvin's car is fixed and going strong, and shares that he has been hanging out with friends at parks lately, arranging regular walks together. Calvin agrees that regular walks with friends can be a wonderful way to spend time together and stay active, noting that fresh air and buddies can do wonders. Dave mentions that he is going to his favorite spot today and shares a lovely photo of a city skyline with a river and boats in the water. Calvin admires the view, describing the sunset over the river as gorgeous and stating that it must be tranquil there. He compares it to living in his Japanese mansion with an epic cityscape, sharing a photo he took from his backyard of the mansion, which shows a boat docked in a canal at sunset. Dave agrees that peace by the river is nice, but expresses that living in a Japanese mansion surrounded by a city skyline must be stunning, noting that the views must be amazing. Calvin confirms that it really is beautiful, stating that whenever he looks out the windows, he sees city lights, which is awe-inspiring. He shares a photo of the front part of the mansion, which is a large house with many windows and lights. Dave admires the mansion, stating that the view from inside must be stunning and expressing that it must be amazing living there. Calvin thanks Dave and shares that he is looking forward to trying the food and checking out the culture in Japan. He asks Dave if he has ever been to Japan, to which Dave replies that he has never been but is keen to go one day, mentioning that he has heard it is full of vibes, good eats, and awesome tech, and that experiencing the culture would be amazing as he is hooked on their music. Calvin agrees, stating that Japan has it all—vibes, food, tech, and amazing culture—and shares that he is working on cool music collaborations with Japanese artists, expressing excitement about how it will turn out. Dave expresses enthusiasm for Calvin's collaborations, stating that working with them is a great chance and he can't wait for the tunes. Calvin promises to share clips when everything is ready, expressing that collaborating with artists is exciting and a chance to create something unique. Dave encourages Calvin, stating that collaborating with artists to create special sounds is amazing and he can't wait to see or hear the end product. Calvin thanks Dave for his support and expresses that it is going to be awesome, stating that he can't wait to show it. He concludes by saying it was great catching up and that he needs to get back to work now, wishing Dave to take care. Dave reciprocates the sentiment, telling Calvin to take care and not to overwork.
As of 17 November, 2023, Dave reaches out to Calvin, stating that it has been a long time since they last spoke and sharing that he has taken up photography, which has been great for him as he enjoys taking pictures of the scenery around him. Calvin responds enthusiastically, expressing excitement to see Dave's photos. He shares that he attended a fancy gala in Boston the previous day, where he met interesting people, and shares a photo of himself and his crew, showing a group of men sitting on a rock next to a river. Dave admires the photo and asks Calvin who he had the most interesting chat with at the gala. Calvin shares that he had an inspiring conversation with a cool artist about music and art, discussing their favorite artists and how the power of music connects everyone. Calvin feels that the conversation was inspiring and that he is on a creative high. Dave responds positively, sharing a photo of his new vintage camera that he bought this month, which takes awesome photos. Calvin asks if Dave uses the camera for his photos, and Dave confirms that it helps him capture special moments clearly. Calvin agrees that a good camera is key for capturing special moments and asks what Dave likes to take photos of. Dave shares a photo of a sunset with a wave crashing on rocks, expressing his love for capturing the beauty of nature. Calvin praises Dave's photography skills, stating that the shot looks great and that nature is amazing. Dave agrees, noting that nature can convey much emotion and beauty through photos. Calvin reflects on how nature helps appreciate life, especially during tough times, describing it as a breath of fresh air. Dave shares another photo of a peaceful scene with rocks and a waterfall, stating that he found a serene spot in a nearby park. Calvin expresses excitement about visiting the peaceful spot and shares a beautiful picture he shot in a Japanese garden, showing a bench under a tree with pink flowers. Dave finds Calvin's photo cool and mentions that he found a better spot with a bench under a tree with pink flowers, describing it as a perfect place to relax and take in beauty. Calvin expresses eagerness to check it out. Dave then shares that he has accepted an invitation to perform at an upcoming show in Boston, describing it as an unforgettable musical experience and promising to fill Calvin in on the details soon. Dave congratulates Calvin on the gala attendance and upcoming performance, expressing excitement to hear about it and suggesting they catch up soon.
As of 21 June, 2023, Calvin greets Dave, expressing that it has been a long time since they last spoke. Calvin shares that he had a little car accident the previous Friday, which was upsetting, but he is relieved that no one was hurt. He mentions that he has been dealing with insurance and repairs, which have been taking up his time and energy, and shares a photo of a red car with a black rim parked on a sidewalk. Dave expresses sympathy for Calvin's car accident, glad to hear that nobody was hurt, and acknowledges that dealing with insurance and repairs can be time-consuming and draining. He asks Calvin if he has encountered any issues in the insurance process so far. Calvin thanks Dave for checking in and explains that the insurance process was a hassle, taking forever and involving a ton of paperwork, but it is all sorted now, and he is getting his car fixed up. He expresses excitement about driving it again and shares a photo from the auto repair shop, showing a tow truck parked in a parking lot. Dave asks how long it took to get everything sorted out and expresses relief that it is all taken care of now. Calvin responds that it only took a week to sort everything out, mentioning that he was worried about the cost, but it wasn't too bad. He shares a photo of a mechanic working on a car in a garage and identifies the mechanic as the person who knows what he is doing and is doing his best to get Calvin's car running again. Dave expresses happiness that it wasn't expensive and asks who the mechanic is. Calvin identifies the mechanic as someone skilled and knowledgeable, expressing confidence in their expertise. Dave agrees that it is great to trust the people fixing the car and expresses optimism that Calvin will be back to normal soon. Calvin thanks Dave, expressing excitement to drive again and shares a photo of a view of a small town with a mountain in the background, describing it as a wonderful view from his living room. Dave admires the view and asks where it is, stating that he hasn't seen anything like it before. Calvin explains that the view is from a small town in Japan and describes the mountains as unbelievably stunning. Dave expresses amazement and asks if Calvin has been to that place yet. Calvin responds that he has not been there before, but it is on his to-do list for after the tour with Frank Ocean ends, expressing eagerness to see the mountains in person. He shares a photo of a person skiing on a snowy mountain and Dave asks if Calvin has ever tried skiing, stating that it looks like loads of fun. Calvin admits that he hasn't tried skiing before but thinks it looks like a lot of fun and might give it a try once. He then asks Dave about anything new in his daily routine, sharing a photo of a plane flying over a mountain range with snow on top. Dave shares that he recently joined a rock band and has been practicing guitar, showing a photo of a group of men playing instruments in a room. Calvin expresses excitement about Dave playing guitar in a rock band, stating that it must bring a lot of emotions. Dave agrees, stating that good company and great music lift the mood and bring positive emotions. He mentions that he has to go now and will see Calvin soon. Calvin thanks Dave and expresses a desire to keep in touch and take care.

Joanna confirms she has been making various desserts that cater to everyone's diets and promises to share more recipes soon. Nate expresses his eagerness to try them and suggests joining her in the kitchen, believing that baking brings people together. Joanna agrees and asks Nate for tips on dairy-free baking. Joanna thanks Nate for his ideas and expresses excitement to try them out.
As of 24 June, 2022, Joanna greets Nate, stating that it has been a long time since they last spoke. Joanna shares that she has submitted her recent screenplay to a film contest to see how others might like it. Nate responds positively, expressing that he hopes it does well. He shares that he has been doing great, mentioning that his gaming party was a great success, and he played some chess afterward for fun. Joanna inquires if Nate's friends liked the controller accessories he provided for the gaming party, and Nate replies that most of them did, although he cannot say if all will continue to use them.
